goal: Group things by a named rule (food, colour, kind) and see that the same things can be grouped by different rules - the right rule explains a mystery (who leaves the red gifts).
cover: In an autumn orchard with falling red and yellow leaves, Squirrel holds a magnifying glass over a small pile of red gifts (a red apple, a red leaf, a red toy block) while Deer looks on curiously; behind a tree trunk the Fox peeks out shyly.
